title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts tracked by git
description:
Commit d83cbc5 adds 3 Rust build artifacts under `rust/target/debug/` (`.d` dep file, `dep-graph.part.bin`, `.lock` incremental file). The `rust/target/` directory is not in `.gitignore` and contains thousands of tracked build-output files (`rust/target/doc/`, `rust/target/debug/`). Build artifacts should never be committed - they are generated, platform-specific, and change with every build.

Fix: add `rust/target/` to `.gitignore` and remove tracked artifacts with `git rm -r --cached rust/target/`.
